summary: The comment from Shaker Heights City Schools expresses support for preserving the core E-Rate program and avoiding federal screen-time limits, emphasizing the importance of affordable broadband and network solutions for schools and libraries. The comment opposes the potential sunset of E-Rate and supports preserving its core functions, emphasizing the importance of affordable broadband and network solutions for schools and students.

claims.requested_action: Preserve E-Rate funding and avoid sunset
claims.argument: E-Rate supports affordable broadband and network solutions
claims.evidence_quote: C to preserve the core strengths of E-Rate, including support for affordable broadband, Internet access, internal connections, Wi-Fi, maintenance, and cost-effective network solutions
